reason: Both correctly identified 22E as the fridge evaporator fan fault, likely ice-related, and both prescribed a full unplugged manual defrost with engineer escalation if it recurs, and neither raised warranty. Conversation 1 asked a sharper question (freezer status plus noises), correctly read the ticking/scraping as the fan hitting ice, gave the 24-48h guidance cleanly and pre-empted the recurrence scenario with accurate engineer advice; its only flaw was a slightly off-topic 'sealed system' reference image. Conversation 2 reached the same conclusion but mislabelled the defrost heater/thermostat as 'sealed-system' components and sent the customer on a drain-hole detour that is not accessible without removing the back panel, wasting a turn and causing confusion before it correctly told them to book a repair.
